---
title: Backtick runs inside Jupyter cells
format: html
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      # bd-f63cqoke: needs a live python3 kernel.
      requires: jupyter
    html:
      noErrors: true
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        # Each marker is assembled at run time, so it appears in the HTML
        # only if the cell actually executed (the source never contains it).
        - ["MID-LINE-RAN", "ASIS-RAN", "CONTROL-RAN", 'class="[^"]*panel-tabset']
        # The bug left the cell as an inert block with class `{python}`.
        - ['class="\{python\}']
---

A backtick run of three or more anywhere in a cell's source makes the qmd
writer lengthen the cell's fence. Such a cell must still run (bd-f63cqoke).

```{python}
print("a ``` b " + "MID-LINE-" + "RAN")
```

The `output: asis` use case from GH #1156: a cell that prints a tabset
holding a fenced code block.

```{python}
#| output: asis
print("::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n## pip\n\n```bash\npip install " + "ASIS-" + "RAN\n```\n\n:::")
```

```{python}
print("CONTROL-" + "RAN")
```
